findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (53.53 yds from volume vs 47.38 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.69 per player (projected 30.9, actual 31.6).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is under-projected by 0.02 (projected 7.21, actual 7.22).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 66.57, without it 64.92. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 34/93 (36.56%). Our MAE 65.7 vs the line's 59.55. The book is the better projection.
